tasteProfile.headline: Taste & How to Use
tasteProfile.description: Smoky, mineral, savoury, with a gentle egg-like note from the high-heat roast.
tasteProfile.usageRule: A small pinch is enough. Use it as a finishing salt, not for cooking.

fiveUses.title: On Fried or Boiled Eggs
fiveUses.description: A single morning pinch unlocks deep savoury warmth over runny yolks and soft-boiled farm eggs.

fiveUses.title: On Grilled Meat or Paneer
fiveUses.description: Crisp brownish crystals crackle against sizzling charred meat or hot paneer tikka, creating a smoky umami crust.

fiveUses.title: On Fresh Watermelon or Mango
fiveUses.description: The mineral smokiness cuts through sweet, chilled tropical fruit slices for an unexpected culinary revelation.

fiveUses.title: On Dark Chocolate or Caramel
fiveUses.description: Delicate crystals sprinkled over warm fudge, bitter dark chocolate truffles, or sea salt caramel.

fiveUses.title: On Cocktail Rims
fiveUses.description: Rim a Mezcalita, Bloody Mary, or spicy Margarita with smoky bamboo salt for an unforgettable aroma with every sip.

recipes.title: Soft-Boiled Eggs with Bambaura 9X Pinch
recipes.description: The gentle egg-like sulfur aroma of roasted bamboo salt pairs symbiotically with fresh eggs, creating rich umami without heavy sauces.
instructions: Lower eggs into gently boiling water for 6.5 minutes.
Transfer immediately to an ice bath for 2 minutes to halt cooking.
Peel carefully and slice in half onto warm buttered sourdough.
Finish with a delicate pinch of Bambaura 9X directly over the warm yolks.

recipes.title: Charred Ribeye or Tandoori Paneer
recipes.description: High-heat searing meets mineral-rich crunch. Sprinkle coarse crystals right before serving so they do not dissolve prematurely.
ingredients: Prime ribeye steak or 250g fresh paneer cubes
1 tbsp clarified butter (ghee) or mustard oil
Fresh herbs or charred lemon wedge
instructions: Sear meat or paneer on a smoking hot cast-iron skillet until deeply caramelized.
Rest on a warm plate for 5 minutes.
Scatter Bambaura 9X Coarse Crystals across the charred surface just before serving.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon & Alphonso Mango Crudo
recipes.description: Mineral smokiness enhances natural fructose, transforming summer fruit into an elevated table course.
ingredients: Thick wedges of cold ripe watermelon or sliced Alphonso mango
Few drops of fresh lime juice
instructions: Arrange cold fruit slices on a wide serving platter.
Squeeze fresh lime juice lightly over the fruit.
Garnish with mint leaves and dust with a delicate pinch of Bambaura 9X.

recipes.title: Smoky Mezcal & Citrus Cocktail Rim
recipes.description: Elevate your bar experience. The distinctive roasted aroma greets the nose before the first sip touches the tongue.
ingredients: 1 tbsp Bambaura 9X Granules on a flat saucer
instructions: Run a fresh lime wedge around the rim of a chilled rocks glass.
Gently press the rim into Bambaura 9X salt crystals on the saucer.
Shake cocktail ingredients with ice, strain into glass, and enjoy.

decantingRitual.title: Tear To Open

decantingRitual.title: Reseal After Use

decantingRitual.title: Fine Brownish Granules
decantingRitual.description: Pinch uniform granules over everyday dishes for a distinctive savoury, smoky finish.
